description: This file contains the implementation of classes related to stream namespace predicate providers in the Orleans framework, including default and constructor-based predicate providers, with methods for pattern matching and predicate creation.

classes.name: DefaultStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides default stream namespace predicates based on pattern matching, supporting wildcards, regex, and exact matches.

classes.name: ConstructorStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Supports constructing stream namespace predicates dynamically, with pattern formatting and parsing capabilities.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to parse a predicate pattern string and produce an appropriate IStreamNamespacePredicate object.

methods.name: FormatPattern
methods.description: Creates a pattern string for a predicate type with an optional constructor argument.
